name: Doylestown
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Doylestown, PA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Doylestown, Pennsylvania for 2026: the historic tree lighting, Santa's Cottage, holiday movies and a youth musical.
lede: Doylestown turns its borough center into Doylestown Winterfest, with a 100-plus-year-old tree lighting, a Santa parade, a free Santa's Cottage and family movies at the County Theater.
celebrates: Discover Doylestown stages Doylestown Winterfest, the borough's holiday calendar, and the Doylestown Borough tree lighting is its centerpiece. Patch reports that thousands gather at Main and State streets in front of the historic Fountain House, where a 20-foot spruce is lit after a parade escorts Santa and Mrs. Claus by fire truck. Santa then opens his cottage at the Hamilton Lot, and Small Business Saturday brings shoppers back downtown the next day. The County Theater, Temple Judea and Doylestown Theatre Academy add movies, a Hanukkah celebration and a holiday musical through December.
lastyear: The Bucks County Herald covered the 111th annual tree lighting on Black Friday 2025, which it said drew thousands to the ceremony and parade at State and Main streets. Santa Claus was raised in a cherry picker, two costumed characters from the Wicked musical were a hit with the crowd, and the North Carolina band Hay Sugar performed. Discover Doylestown presented the evening as part of Doylestown Winterfest, and the 2026 ceremony is the 112th.
facts: Patch says this year's tree is a 20-foot Oriental spruce donated by Bountiful Acres, which has donated a tree to the borough for nine years. The paper describes the tree lighting as a tradition reaching back more than a century, to a time when indoor plumbing, telephones and automobiles were still luxuries in many households. Santa leaves the fire truck and rides a bucket truck high above the crowd to light the tree, and parking along the parade route is restricted until about 8:30 pm.
trains: Doylestown does not have its own Christmas train, but one of the region's best is a short drive away. New Hope Railroad runs Santa's North Pole Express and Santa's Steam Train Ride from the historic New Hope station, and Visit Bucks County lists the North Pole Express from November 20 to December 30, 2026. Families can look at the New Hope page on this site for the dated train listing, and the museum guide has the railroad's page.
train_links: The 1891 station and heritage railroad in New Hope, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: A borough tradition at Main and State streets, with a parade, live music and Santa lifted high above the crowd.
A cottage at the Hamilton Lot where Discover Doylestown says pictures with Santa are free.
The day after the tree lighting, shops downtown offer discounts and gifts, with free parking at the county garages, according to Patch.
Discover Doylestown and Borough Parks and Recreation hold a stroller and wagon walk at Broad Commons Park, collecting donations for local pantries.
The County Theater shows holiday films on weekend mornings leading up to Christmas Eve.
kidfact: Santa does not take the stairs in Doylestown. He rides a bucket truck up above the crowd to switch on the tree.
faq: Doylestown runs Doylestown Winterfest through Discover Doylestown. The borough tree lighting and parade open the season, Santa's Cottage welcomes families at the Hamilton Lot, and the County Theater, Temple Judea and local theatre groups add movies, a Hanukkah celebration and a holiday musical.
How old is the Doylestown tree lighting?
Patch calls it a tradition reaching back more than a century, and the 2026 ceremony is the 112th, according to Discover Doylestown. The Bucks County Herald covered the 111th in 2025.
Where do kids meet Santa in Doylestown?
Santa arrives at the tree lighting by fire truck and then opens his cottage at the Hamilton Lot, where Discover Doylestown says pictures are free.
Is there a holiday movie in Doylestown for kids?
Yes. The County Theater runs a Family Matinee Series on weekend mornings, including The Polar Express and Elf, and Doylestown Winterfest lists the lineup.
